title: Lua stub manifest (lua/_files.json)
description: The stub files the server loads from lua/, in load order. A stub file that exists in the repo but is missing here is never read; a server older than this manifest reads api.d.lua alone.

files.description: File names relative to lua/, no directories. Every entry is a ---@meta file.

libraries.description: The stubs that stand in for a script library, by the module name a script requires (matched case-insensitively). The Lua analyzer reads such a stub only for a script whose require tree names the module and no project layer ships its file; where a layer ships it, the file itself is read with the stub annotations written into it. A stub not listed here describes the engine and is read for every script. A server older than this key ignores it.

entryPoints.description: The entry-point list relative to lua/ (see lua-entry-points.schema.json): documentation the server reads and the Lua analyzer does not. A server older than this key ignores it.
